systems.system: civil registration records held by the Officier de l'Etat Civil at the mayor's office
systems.owner: the office of the mayor of each town
systems.tiers: local only: records are held in the office of the mayor of the town where the event occurred, or for births where the mother lives; no single nationwide repository (effective 5 February 2025)

note: The US Social Security Administration states, effective 5 February 2025, that Burundi has no single nationwide repository of civil registration records and that they are held locally; it does not say whether the local record is paper or digital, so no aspect value can be taken and the holding is left unclassified.
